newsitem.title: JAPAN: DuPont subsidiaries to set up sales firm in Japan.
newsitem.headline: DuPont subsidiaries to set up sales firm in Japan.

text.p: DuPont KK said on Tuesday that it, DuPont Dow Elastomers Ltd, DuPont Showa Denko Co Ltd and Showa Denko KK had agreed to set up a marketing joint venture.

The firm, which is expected to start operations in the first half of 1997, will undertake all sales, marketing, technical and customer support operations for DuPont Dow and DuPont Showa Denko's synthetic rubber products, the company said in a statement.
"The joint venture is part of a plan to significantly increase market presence," the statement said.
DuPont Dow Elastomers is the Japanese subsidiary of DuPont Dow Elastomers L.L.C., which was set up as an equally owned joint venture between the DuPont Co and Dow Chemical Co in April.
DuPont Show Denko, Dupont's first joint venture operation in Japan, is a 50/50 venture of DuPont and Showa Denko and was formed in 1960 to manufacture and sell performance elastomers.
